applicable_scope: 0.2.9-development release qualification; not a public release authorization
purpose: Audit the consolidated qualification ledger and claims, execute the repository's existing release-quality, engineering, documentation, packaging, and public-source gates, and prepare an immutable Owner-review dossier.

included: Validate 0.2.9 progress ledger, Owner decisions, active point allocation, and progress documentation consistency.
Review public claims against the versioned bounded qualification evidence and preserve all recorded limitations.
Run the local Windows/Python 3.13 equivalent of the repository quality workflow and the complete engineering/documentation verification jobs where supported.
Validate documentation registry/build, source archive, package build/install surface, and release-source hygiene.
excluded_owner_gates: Awarding WP14 points or modifying the official ledger.
Changing the public package version, release date, changelog release section, or citation version.
Creating/pushing a release tag, publishing to PyPI/GitHub/Zenodo, or merging this branch.
Claiming unexecuted operating-system/Python matrix results or external-platform CI results.

frozen_gates.acceptance: The candidate is based on the exact governing SHA; the contract and execution SHAs are resolvable; the final evidence commit has a clean tree; all evidence hashes match.

progress.json, progress.md, owner_decisions.json and the Owner-confirmed active allocation agree: 95/100 before WP14, WP14=0/1, active WP13/WP14/WP15 allocation=1/1/2, total allocation=100. The frozen historical roadmap is not rewritten.

The current capability/qualification registries and public-facing claims do not promote candidate, experimental, bounded, or unvalidated scopes beyond their Owner-accepted evidence; registry/document references resolve; limitations and historical failures remain visible.

Run the quality.yml standard-baseline commands on the available Windows/Python 3.13 environment: Ruff, progressive mypy, unit+integration tests excluding benchmark/large/evidence with branch coverage >=80%, P0 coverage check, compileall, and both quick-verification commands. Record unavailable matrix legs separately as NOT_RUN, never PASS.
commands: python -m ruff check src/qf_solver src/solveur tests scripts
python -m mypy src/solveur/core/errors.py src/solveur/core/qualification.py src/solveur/io/manifest.py src/solveur/verification/traceability.py

python -m pytest tests/unit tests/integration -m 'not benchmark and not large and not evidence' --cov=solveur --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=80 --cov-report=json:coverage.json --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
python -m compileall -q src scripts tests qf_solver.py main_solveur.py mitc4_solver.py

frozen_gates.acceptance: Run the existing quality.yml engineering job: full MITC4 verification and verify-all --profile engineering. Do not weaken or skip a failing gate.

Run controlled meshed benchmark tests, engineering documentation generation, documentation tests with evidence enabled, strict MkDocs build, and packaging integration tests using the repository's declared workflow commands.

Build wheel and sdist without publishing; inspect package metadata/content; run public-source, release-archive, and history hygiene audits. Actual release tag/readiness remains OWNER_GATED and is not created by this campaign.
Only claim platform legs actually executed. The committed GitHub Actions matrix is Windows/Ubuntu x Python 3.10/3.13; CI on this exact WP14 candidate is not inferred from a local Windows run.
No tag, publication, governing merge, push, or official point award occurs. These remain explicit Owner decisions after reviewing the dossier.

required_evidence: execution SHA and evidence commit SHA
per-command argv, UTC start/end, exit code, concise result, and output SHA-256
machine-readable gate summary and human-readable audit report
wheel/sdist hashes and package metadata inspection
working-tree state and production-source diff summary
explicit list of platform legs not executed and Owner-only release actions

final_status_rule.pass_candidate: All locally executable gates pass, the ledger/claims/provenance audits pass, and platform/publication limitations are explicit.
final_status_rule.hold: Any required local gate fails, evidence is missing, provenance/hash differs, ledger conflicts, or a claim exceeds its evidence.
final_status_rule.official_award: Never derived by this runner; requires explicit Owner decision.
